title: ATLANTIC: Structure-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Language Model for Interdisciplinary Science
summary: This community centers on the 2023 paper 'ATLANTIC: Structure-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Language Model for Interdisciplinary Science,' which proposes a novel approach to integrating structural awareness into retrieval-augmented generation. The work is authored by Sai Munikoti, Anurag Acharya, Sridevi Wagle, and Sameera Horawalavithana. It is cited within a broader context of research involving knowledge graphs, large language models, and interdisciplinary scientific applications.
key_findings: The ATLANTIC paper was published in 2023 and is available on arXiv (arXiv:2311.12289 [cs.CL]).
The model is specifically designed to be 'structure-aware,' distinguishing it from standard retrieval-augmented language models.
The primary application domain of the proposed model is interdisciplinary science.
Sai Munikoti, Anurag Acharya, Sridevi Wagle, and Sameera Horawalavithana are the four identified authors of the work.
The paper is referenced in a survey or technical document alongside other works on knowledge graphs (e.g., TUDataset, OpenDialKG) and LLM applications (e.g., GPT-4, financial LLMs).
